svg.title: Massachusetts primary-care access: investigation shortlist and physician supply
svg.desc: Left: map of the 14 Massachusetts counties, with the six baseline shortlist counties (Bristol, Dukes, Essex, Franklin, Hampden, Plymouth) filled in blue. Right: primary-care physicians per 100,000 residents by county, sorted ascending, with the county median cutoff of 78.8 marked.
svg.text: Capacity below the county median, with poverty or age-65+ at or above the state benchmark
County boundaries: Census cartographic boundary file; exterior rings only.
Nonfederal primary-care MDs and DOs in
patient care; excludes residents and age 75+.
